mapper.select: SELECT f.faq_sq AS faqSq, f.faq_type_cd AS faqTypeCd, c.common_code_nm AS categoryNm, f.question_ttl AS questionTtl, f.answer_cn AS answerCn, f.faq_created_at_dtm AS faqCreatedAtDtm, f.faq_modified_at_dtm AS modifiedAt, f.faq_is_deleted_yn AS isDeletedYn FROM tbl_faq_m f LEFT JOIN tbl_common_code_c c ON f.faq_type_cd = c.common_code_sq WHERE f.faq_sq = #{faqSq}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_faq_m ( faq_type_cd, question_ttl, answer_cn, faq_created_at_dtm, faq_modified_at_dtm, faq_is_deleted_yn ) VALUES ( #{faqTypeCd}, #{questionTtl}, #{answerCn}, NOW(), NOW(), 'N' )
mapper.update: UPDATE tbl_faq_m SET faq_type_cd = #{faqTypeCd}, question_ttl = #{questionTtl}, answer_cn = #{answerCn}, faq_modified_at_dtm = NOW() WHERE faq_sq = #{faqSq}
UPDATE tbl_faq_m SET faq_is_deleted_yn = #{isDeletedYn}, faq_modified_at_dtm = NOW() WHERE faq_sq = #{faqSq}
